name: Key performance indicator (KPI)
short_description: A key performance indicator is a measure used to judge how well an organization, process or activity is meeting its objectives. The episode argues that a KPI should act as a decision rule with an owner, a trigger and a pre-committed action.

evidence.quote: Every organization eventually gets the same request, put every KPI on one page.
A KPI in architectural terms is a rule that binds observation to a decision surface.
